in_sanskrit.name: मुकुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power to perform pooja, worship and has the capability to please the deities.

in_hindi.name: मुठुकुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who performs pooja and worship, or the one who is strong and powerful, or the one who is simple-minded.

in_tamil.name: முத்துகுமார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who performs pooja and is a devotee, the one who is a hero, or the one who is a leader in his community.

in_telugu.name: మూఠుకుమార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who performs pooja and is devoted to it, the one who is powerful and has the ability to please the gods, or the one who is a ruler or king.

in_marathi.name: Muthukumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's grace, protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muthukumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muthu means 'God's grace'. Kumar means 'protector'. This name is derived from the ancient Indian scriptures and signifies the divine protection granted to an individual.

in_bengali.name: Muthukumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's grace, protector
in_bengali.long_meaning: Muthukumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Muthu means 'God's grace'. Kumar means 'protector'. This name is derived from the ancient Indian scriptures and signifies the divine protection granted to an individual.
